title: Word order in reported questions
hint: Word order like in a statement: **subject + verb**. No *do / does / did*, no question mark.

items.direct: Tyler to Mila: "Where do you live?"
options: Tyler asked Mila where did she live.
Tyler asked Mila where she lived.
Tyler asked Mila where she lives?
items.answer: Tyler asked Mila where she lived.

options: Mila asked what time it was.
Mila asked what time was it.
Mila asked what time is it.
items.answer: Mila asked what time it was.

options: Aisha asked if was Diego at home.
Aisha asked if Diego was at home.
Aisha asked that Diego was at home.
items.answer: Aisha asked if Diego was at home.

items.direct: Sofia to Mila: "Did you enjoy the party?"
options: Sofia asked Mila if she had enjoyed the party.
Sofia asked Mila did she enjoy the party.
Sofia asked Mila if she did enjoyed the party.
items.answer: Sofia asked Mila if she had enjoyed the party.

items.direct: Mila to Sofia: "How old is your brother?"
options: Mila asked Sofia how old was her brother.
Mila asked Sofia how old her brother was.
Mila asked Sofia how old is her brother?
items.answer: Mila asked Sofia how old her brother was.

items.direct: Coach Brooks to Tyler: "Why didn't you come to practice?"
options: Coach Brooks asked Tyler why he hadn't come to practice.
Coach Brooks asked Tyler why didn't he come to practice.
Coach Brooks asked Tyler why he didn't came to practice.
items.answer: Coach Brooks asked Tyler why he hadn't come to practice.

items.direct: Diego to Mila: "Will you be at the game?"
options: Diego asked Mila if she would be at the game.
Diego asked Mila if would she be at the game.
Diego asked Mila will she be at the game.
items.answer: Diego asked Mila if she would be at the game.

items.direct: Mrs Moreno to Mila: "What are you reading?"
options: Mrs Moreno asked Mila what she was reading.
Mrs Moreno asked Mila what was she reading.
Mrs Moreno asked Mila what she is reading?
items.answer: Mrs Moreno asked Mila what she was reading.
